items.title: 4.2.5 Graph: Best for Networked Data (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a graph (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Kab istemal karein: jab cheezon (nodes) aur un ke darmiyan rabton (edges) ko dikhana ho to graph istemal hota hai. Networks wale masail mein graphs khaas taur par mufeed hain, jaise:

items: Social networks: users aur un ke rabte (dost, followers) dikhana.
Pathfinding algorithms: naqshon ya games mein sab se chhota raasta dhoondna.
Dependency resolution: aise software projects jin ke hisse ek doosre par munhasir hon, un ki build ki tarteeb tay karna.

blocks.prompt: Maps app sarkon ko weighted graph kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Chowk vertices, sarkein edges, aur faasla ya safar ka waqt weights hain; is se app sab se chhota ya tez raasta dhoond leti hai.
